sentence: This project builds a tool that uses optical imaging to measure how tumors take up nutrients in animal models of human cancers.
This project builds and tests a mental health literacy intervention about trauma and substance use, developed together with a community advisory board.
This project tests whether an ultrasound-based imaging method can find where arrhythmias start and show whether their treatment worked.
This project studies how a cold sensor ion channel affects corneal nerve recovery and how it changes as the cornea heals after injury.
This project studies how changes in inhibitory synaptic transmission after global cerebral ischemia lead to synaptic dysfunction and memory impairments.
This project studies how pathogenic T cells become activated in a neuroinflammatory syndrome, using human and mouse immunology and genome engineering.
This project builds and tests a tool that gives older adults in skilled nursing facilities personalized prognostic information to guide decision-making.
This project studies the biological factors behind differences in outcomes of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma across patient populations.
This project studies how high-fat diets cause skin inflammation by activating T cells that recognize self-lipids.
This project studies how environmental exposures interact with genetic and epigenetic factors to contribute to chronic and acute diseases.
This project studies molecular impairments directly in the brains of people who abuse opioids including heroin.
This project uses mouse models with different genetic alterations to study what hinders treatment of small cell lung cancer and to test drug combinations.
This project builds a robot system that plans and guides needle biopsies for lung cancer under CT guidance.
This project tries to improve survival of lung cancer patients by finding better ways to detect it early and to treat late-stage disease.
This project uses CRISPR to make small cell lung cancer cell lines and mouse models for testing treatments.
This project uses mass spectrometry to study a wide range of molecules in cancer biology.
This project studies whether a long non-coding RNA can ease cardiac hypertrophy caused by pressure overload, using mutant mouse models.
This project uses metagenomic sequencing and samples from a clinical trial to study the risks of infections spread by blood transfusion.
This project tests a method that infects blastocysts in utero with a lentivirus to study genes in the trophoblast during placental development.
